cases.decision: Compare normal cached loads, deterministic initial sampler order, and driver rebuild in fresh process pairs on the same synthetic 64-sample 3D LUT. The paired Vice-Tay report observed 3 distinct cached results after the order changed and all 64 after rebuild. A test can compare image correctness against rebuild cost, with empty-cache control. Do not infer the cause inside the driver.
